project.description: This job loads the secondary terms from the UniProt data into the database. This includes the following: - Interpro - GO - EC - ProSite - Pfam The primary load for the UniProt data must be run first.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Check this option to commit the results of the load. Otherwise, it's a dry run.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: LOAD_INTERPRO2GO_EC2GO
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Keep deriving interpro2go and ec2go GO annotations in this load (default: yes). Uncheck once the unified DANRE-mod GO load supplies them (ZFIN-10344). WARNING: unchecking this alone DUPLICATES rather than replaces -- the DANRE-mod load writes the same content under the GOA organization while these rows are owned by UniProt, so the cutover must also purge gafOrganization='UniProt'. Existing rows are left frozen (neither refreshed nor pruned) while unchecked.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: LOAD_KW2GO
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Keep deriving UniProtKB-Keyword (kw2go) GO annotations in this load (default: yes). WARNING: unlike interpro2go/ec2go there is NO successor for this stream -- GO retired GO_REF:0000004 and neither DANRE file carries it -- so unchecking this strands ~41k annotations with nothing else supplying them. Unresolved decision; see README-danre-mod-consolidation.md open decision 4.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: TIMESTAMP=`date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S` echo "WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE" echo "PWD=$PWD" echo "UNIPROT_LOAD_MODE=$UNIPROT_LOAD_MODE" rm -f $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report.json $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report.json.report.html $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report*.json.zip $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report*.html.zip export UNIPROT_OUTPUT_FILE="$PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report_$TIMESTAMP.json.zip" cd $SOURCEROOT # -D rather than relying on the environment: a forked JavaExec inherits the gradle daemon's # environment, not this shell's. See ZFIN-10344. gradle uniprotSecondaryTermLoadTask \ -DLOAD_INTERPRO2GO_EC2GO=$LOAD_INTERPRO2GO_EC2GO \ -DLOAD_KW2GO=$LOAD_KW2GO
